policyText.privacyPolicy: At Moonlight Crescent, customer privacy is paramount. We only collect details necessary for processing your order and fulfilling delivery within Nigeria.
policyText.termsAndConditions: All orders placed are confirmed via call or WhatsApp before dispatch. Payment on delivery is available nationwide across Nigeria upon package inspection.
policyText.returnsPolicy: 1-Year Comprehensive Warranty plus 7-day inspection and exchange period upon delivery. Items must remain in original protective packaging.

faqText.question: 1. What is the A-01 Deadbolt Type Smart Lock?
faqText.answer: The A-01 is a premium deadbolt type smart door lock featuring 6-in-1 multi-access: 3D Face Recognition via an infrared cat-eye camera, 4.0-inch interior HD IPS color display screen, 0.3s semiconductor biometric fingerprint, anti-peep capacitive touch passcode, RFID IC smart card swipe, mobile app remote control via Tuya/Smart Life, and physical emergency mechanical keys.

faqText.question: 2. How does the 3D Face Recognition & 4.0-inch Interior Screen work?
faqText.answer: The exterior unit is equipped with a high-precision 3D infrared cat-eye camera that recognizes authorized faces in under 0.5 seconds, even in pitch-black night conditions or with hats and glasses. When someone approaches or rings the built-in doorbell, the interior 4.0-inch high-definition screen lights up instantly so you can see exactly who is outside before opening the door.

faqText.question: 3. What happens if the battery runs down completely?
faqText.answer: The lock is equipped with dual emergency fail-safes. First, there is an external Type-C USB emergency power interface at the bottom that you can power instantly using any mobile power bank. Second, 2 high-security laser-cut mechanical override keys are included to unlock the door manually at any time. The high-capacity rechargeable lithium battery lasts 6 to 8 months per charge and alerts you well in advance when battery drops below 20%.

faqText.question: 4. Will it fit my door? (Installation & Compatibility)
faqText.answer: Yes! The A-01 Deadbolt Smart Lock is engineered to fit standard Nigerian residential and commercial doors with thicknesses between 40mm and 100mm. It works seamlessly on modern wooden doors, armored security doors, steel doors, stainless steel doors, and composite doors. Full mounting hardware, strike plate, and installation template are included.

faqText.question: 5. How does delivery work across Nigeria?
faqText.answer: We deliver nationwide across all 36 states and the FCT. Base delivery is FREE nationwide! If you choose Motor Park Delivery, it is 100% FREE and requires no street address — simply pick your preferred transit terminal. In Lagos State, Doorstep Delivery is completely FREE (no extra fee). In other states, Doorstep Delivery attracts an extra fee of ₦5,000. Plus, enjoy an instant ₦5,000 discount for every additional lock ordered!

faqText.question: 6. Can I generate temporary passcodes for guests or cleaners?
faqText.answer: Yes. Via the connected Tuya Smart / Smart Life smartphone app, you can create one-time dynamic passwords or time-restricted PIN codes for guests, domestic staff, or Airbnb tenants without revealing your master master code. You also receive real-time push notifications and full unlock history logs on your phone.

faqText.question: 7. How do I contact customer support or confirm via WhatsApp?
faqText.answer: Once you submit your order form, you can immediately confirm with your unique order reference directly on WhatsApp with one click, or call our customer line directly at 08147778029.

reviews.name: Arc. Femi Adeyemi
reviews.comment: Installed this A-01 smart lock on our main apartment entrance door in Ikoyi. The 3D face recognition is instantaneous—as soon as I walk up to the door it unlocks without touching anything. The interior 4-inch screen is a huge blessing for the family.

reviews.name: Barrister Chidinma Okonkwo
reviews.comment: Delivery to Abuja was super fast via Utako transit terminal. Solid build quality, heavy-duty deadbolt. The Tuya app lets me generate temporary codes for my cleaners when I am in court. 100% worth the ₦180,000 investment.

reviews.name: Engr. Kenneth Nwachukwu
reviews.comment: Ordered 2 locks with the multi-item discount for my duplex in PH. The semiconductor fingerprint sensor never fails, even with wet hands. Very reassuring to have the Type-C emergency port and manual keys just in case.

reviews.name: Alhaji Ibrahim Danladi
reviews.comment: Top notch security. The loud doorbell chime and the interior screen make it so safe for my children at home. Excellent customer support when placing the order.
